title: Sunday · twenty-three flyers
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty-three. The wall's two rows have met — the girl is ten and reaches the high row now — and the Sunday draws the join: the last low flyer and the first she pinned high, side by side.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the shingle wall with twenty-three flyers, the low row and the high row meeting at the right.

image.prompt: a shingle wall with a long row of paper flyers where a lower row rises to meet the higher one at the right end, watercolor, no words legible

panels.name: Met

panels.composition: Tier 2: close on the join: one flyer low, the next high, a crab in each corner in the same hand.

image.prompt: close on two paper flyers on shingle, one pinned low and the next pinned high, each with a small ink crab in its corner, watercolor, no words legible

panels.name: Join

panels.composition: Tier 3: a girl of ten pinning at the high row flat-footed, not reaching.

panels.name: Ten

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving
